magnificationHint: Icons grow as the pointer passes over them.
autoHide: Automatically hide and show the Dock
autoHideHint: Rest the pointer at the bottom edge of any display to reveal the Dock there.
genieHint: While it is on, windows do not use the Windows animations for maximizing or closing.
genieOffHint: The genie follows Windows' "Animation effects" setting, as every app should, so it does not play. Choosing "Adjust for best performance" in Windows turns it off too.
showMinimizedHint: As thumbnails on the right side of the Dock, instead of inside their app's icon.
menuBarHint: Time, battery, and access to the Windows quick settings and notifications.
menuBarAutoHide: Automatically hide and show the menu bar
menuBarAutoHideHint: It appears when the pointer rests on the top edge of the screen, never over a window's close buttons.
islandStyleHint: Choose between the centered notch or a compact bubble next to the status indicators.
accessoryBatteryHint: Detects supported mice and headsets and shows their battery levels. While off, no accessories are monitored or queried.
aiUsageHint: Reads your existing sessions. Queries each provider directly every five minutes and does not save credentials.
menuBarBluetoothHint: Show Bluetooth status and open settings beside Wi-Fi.
menuBarBatteryPercentHint: Display the charge percentage next to the battery icon.
menuBarTaskViewHint: Show Task View to manage open windows and virtual desktops.
saveError: The settings could not be saved.
checkUpdatesHint: Settings asks GitHub whether there is a newer version when it opens.
autoUpdateHint: Once a day, a couple of minutes after you turn on the computer (or every 24 hours if it stays on), Muelle installs new versions by itself.
updatesError: Could not check. Check your connection.
showRecentsHint: The last three you opened that are not pinned.
mascotHint: A pixel crab comes out when an AI plan resets or runs out, when you plug in the charger, or when energy saver starts. Hover over it.
resetHint: Back to the out-of-the-box look and behavior. Your pinned apps stay.
updateBannerBody: It brings improvements and fixes. It installs in seconds and the dock comes back on its own.
updateInstallError: The update could not be installed. Check your connection and try again.
shortcutsFolderHint: A folder at the right of the Dock: its contents open as a menu, with a submenu for each folder inside.
